description: Canonical registry of conformance vector identifiers. Every ck.vector.* identifier referenced by prose or fixtures MUST appear here, and every row MUST point at the prose or fixture source that defines it.

vectors.description: Applet transaction push source signature anchor: per-delivery RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature covering method/target/authority/content-digest/source-service-did/destination-service-did/idempotency-key, source_signature_anchor persisted into the idempotency/replay record, duplicate body/anchor conflicts fail closed, and source service authentication does not replace Event actor/applet/capability checks.

Streaming chunked AEAD (ck.blob.stream_aead.v1) happy path: multi-segment plaintext with a short final segment is split, per-segment AEAD encrypted, segment-wise downloaded and incrementally verified, and the top-level ciphertext_digest is recomputed and matches per media-and-blob.md section 3.3.

Streaming AEAD truncation: a dropped final segment, a last segment whose flag stays 0x00, or segment_count exhausted without last_segment_flag=0x01 MUST be rejected with segment_stream_truncated and buffered plaintext discarded.
Streaming AEAD ordering: out-of-order / skipped / gapped segment_index MUST be rejected with segment_sequence_invalid; a repeated segment_index MUST be rejected with segment_replay.

Streaming AEAD scheme closure: an unknown attachment scheme MUST fail closed with unsupported_attachment_scheme (no fallback decrypt); an envelope carrying both whole-file nonce and chunked nonce_prefix/segment_* fields MUST fail blob.schema.json encrypted_attachment oneOf validation.
Accepts the three legal first call states and rejects active or terminal first states.
Covers every legal call lifecycle transition and representative non-terminal illegal transitions.
Terminal call states reject every attempted outgoing transition with call_state_terminal.
Same-basis replay of the same from/to transition is idempotent and does not create a divergent head.
Same-basis sibling transitions to different states return fsm bottom instead of selecting a winner.

Recording retention: audit_lock blocks deletion (legal_hold_active) regardless of retention_expires_at, and entering a capturing recording_state without consent_confirmed fails with recording_consent_required.

Recording ready results MUST carry ck.schema.call_recording_artifact.v1 metadata bound to the recording start event, Cokret blob pipeline, recording exporter label/context, retention policy, deletion audit trigger, and erasure receipt.

Transcription requires ck.call.transcribe (transcription_denied otherwise), and transcript artifacts MUST use the ck-rtc-transcript-key/v1 exporter label with a dedicated Context (transcription_artifact_pipeline_bypassed otherwise).
Moderator kick/ban requires ck.call.moderate (call_moderation_unauthorised otherwise); removed_participants[] gates token re-issue with call_participant_removed.

P2P calls converge to SFU when participants exceed two, reusing the oldest_membership no-vote session_focus election; mode does not auto-downgrade, and ck.call.summary is gated on a terminal call state (call_summary_invalid otherwise).
on_last_read converges by principal-level aggregate contributions and read_trigger_window_ms; offline devices receive expiry stubs and shred keys when they reconnect.
Read-trigger expiry anchors are derived from anonymous aggregate contributions and MUST NOT reveal reader identity or reader counts to other clients or services outside the aggregate boundary.
Duplicate, stale, out-of-order, or cross-bound read-trigger contributions MUST NOT refresh anchors, double-count readers, or expire the wrong message.

Federation ingress authentication-failure family (unknown peer / not authorized / target absent) returns indistinguishable responses within one timing bucket per relation.md section 4.5 sampling rules.

service_binding_ref.reducer_profile_digest is computed per federation.md section 4.1.1 from the reducer-profile-registry.json digest_input row (Cokret canonical JSON, sha256); receiver recomputes and byte-compares, rejecting the whole batch with reducer_profile_mismatch on any divergence.

Realm reducer authority for ck.invite.claim: binding_proof and subject_proof signature transcripts, token_commitment match, verification_service_did allowlist re-check, claim_nonce replay rejection, pending -> claimed membership-proposal conversion, and expiry cleanup are enforced before acceptance.

New passphrase_kdf backup envelopes below the unconditional base KDF floor (Argon2id memory_kib>=65536 / iterations>=3 / parallelism>=1; PBKDF2 iterations>=600000 with allowed digest_algorithm) MUST be rejected.
Key backup retrieval requires a session-bound unlock proof (ck.schema.key_backup_unlock_proof.v1); any binding mismatch or bearer-token-only access fails closed before ciphertext is returned.

Last-resort KeyPackage (ck.feature.mls_last_resort_keypackage.v1): when the normal pool is empty, claim MAY return last_resort=true; the package is reused across multiple Welcomes within the same intended_realm_id, consume is idempotent (stays published, never keypackage_already_consumed), and each consumption emits an append-only audit record per encryption-and-audit.md section 2.6.2.

Last-resort KeyPackage forced rotation: on next online the holder MUST rotate the last-resort package (new init key, old marked rotated) and trigger an MLS self-update Commit on every group joined via it to advance the epoch and close the forward-secrecy weakening window.

Last-resort KeyPackage Realm affinity, optionality, and profile gating: cross-intended_realm_id reuse MUST be rejected with last_resort_realm_affinity_violation; a server not declaring the feature MUST fail closed on an empty pool and MUST NOT return a last_resort package, with explicit last-resort fallback returning last_resort_not_supported; high_security_organization and sovereign_deployment Realms MUST treat last-resort as forbidden even when the service supports the feature.

Appeal verdict transitions are atomic: overturn without a same-batch ck.moderation.decision.lift is rejected with appeal_overturn_missing_lift; modify requires a same-batch new decision matched by modify_decision_ref.

E2EE franking proof construction, report submission, and moderator-side verification roundtrip per content-moderation.md section 3.4; digest mismatch or minimal-disclosure violations downgrade or reject the proof.
Seal canonical bytes exclude id and notary_signature; verifier recomputes the typed id and signature payload digest from signed top-level fields only.
cas_register writes on non-initial state require an explicit CBA basis: Control Move preconditions or equivalent DataEvent causal/lattice proof; null-basis blind overwrites fail closed.
Expired policy decisions and decisions bound to an older auth/policy/membership frontier MUST be rejected on replay; receivers fail closed and re-request the policy check.
Receivers recompute the RFC 8785 JCS request_canonical_digest of the presented request body; mismatch with the signed bound_to transcript MUST reject the decision.

Sender-constrained session PoP: a write request with a valid RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature (kid = current grant session_public_key, covering @method/@target-uri/@authority/content-digest) is accepted; a signature whose transcript mismatches the method/path/body digest fails verification and is rejected per api-conventions.md section 3.2 and service-http-binding.md section 2.5.

Under ck.profile.high_security_organization.v1 / sovereign_deployment, plain Authorization: Bearer (no Signature) on regular writes / sensitive reads MUST be rejected with unauthenticated, while the default profile accepts it as a compatibility downgrade; a PoP signature whose created/expires falls outside the replay window MUST be rejected.
Reserved vector id for high-assurance snapshot inclusion-challenge sampling. Non-gating until a machine fixture and runner assertion are published under artifacts/fixtures/.

Client events.query backfill with include_completeness=true detects withheld actor branches via ck.attestation.range_completeness verification; feature-less servers ignore the parameter; single_source attestation does not satisfy high-assurance realms.
Canonical JSON object key ordering follows UTF-16 code units for supplementary-plane keys.
Blind-index stale postings after revocation, visibility tightening, redaction, expiry, or epoch rotation MUST not produce unauthorized recall.
Search hit is not an authorization proof; unauthorized or unverifiable hits return non-enumerating stubs.
Directory search, privacy-preserving search, and bridge interop surfaces stay separated and do not leak private plaintext.
Receiver rejects sender_nonce_prefix collision or nonce prefix mismatch.
Receiver rejects repeated per-device AEAD nonce counter.
Receiver rejects pure random 96-bit nonce profile for v1 encrypted attachments.
mv_register join/validate_op convergence for the same CBA Event set.
counter join/validate_op convergence for the same CBA Event set.
ordered_log join/validate_op convergence for the same CBA Event set.
fsm join: identical (from,to) sibling transitions converge idempotently; same-from different-to siblings return bottom (reject path).
ordered_log issuer sub-chain seq gap yields contiguous_prefix plus pending_gap diagnostics; deterministic recompute after backfill.
directory_visibility=realm_members exposes only the Realm-member preview field set and gives non-Realm callers the same locked stub/timing bucket as members-only circles.
RSVP occurrence key canonicalizes recurrence instance local wall-clock start in the event timezone.
